Environmental impact:  A  moderate  amount  of  dairy  products  can  be  part  of  an
environmentally sustainable diet. Due to their high consumption, dairy products are a
significant product group in terms of both the environment and nutrition. The climate
impact of cheeses is clearly greater than that of liquid dairy products. Dairy production
is linked to beef production because they share production stages. The environmental
impact of these products must therefore also be considered jointly and at the level of
the  production  system  of  the  whole  cattle  economy.  It  involves  both  beneficial  and
harmful features, including methane emissions typical of ruminants (see Appendix 4).
At the same time, the cattle economy makes use of grasslands, which have a positive
environmental impact compared to annual crops.
